name: Carlsbad
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Carlsbad, CA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Carlsbad, CA: Holiday at the Rancho, the Village Faire tree lighting, free Santa visits and a beachside tree lighting at Cape Rey.
lede: Carlsbad does Christmas by the coast: a Rotary tree lighting in the Village, an evening of lights at a historic ranch, and free Santa visits at the city's outdoor shopping centers.
celebrates: Carlsbad's season starts in early December, when Chandler's at Cape Rey Carlsbad Beach lights its tree beside Ponto Road and The Forum Carlsbad holds its annual tree lighting with Santa and Buddy the Elf. The City of Carlsbad turns Leo Carrillo Ranch Historic Park into Holiday at the Rancho, with crafts, train rides, a movie and Santa. In the Village, the Rotary Club of Carlsbad lights the holiday tree at Village Faire after Santa rolls in on an antique fire truck. Through December, Santa keeps weekend hours at The Forum, and Plaza Paseo Real, already listed on our Vista page, offers free outdoor Santa photos on two Saturdays.
lastyear: In 2025 the Rotary Club of Carlsbad held its 40th Annual Holiday Tree Lighting on Sunday, December 7, at the entrance to Village Faire on Carlsbad Village Drive. Adrienne Nims played holiday music in the courtyard from noon, Santa, Mrs. Claus and an elf arrived in a vintage fire truck at 2:15 pm, and the Rotary Club handed out cookies, coffee and cider. The Carlsbad Library's Learning Center ran storytelling and crafts, and Mayor Keith Blackburn lit the tree at 4:30 pm.
facts: Carlsbad is named after a famous spa town in Europe. Sea captain John A. Frazier dug a well for his farm and struck mineral water, and a chemical test showed it matched the waters of Well Number Nine in Karlsbad, Bohemia. He and merchant Gerhard Schutte sold it as Carlsbad Mineral Water, and the settlement, then called Frazier's Station, took the name Carlsbad. The Carlsbad Mineral Spa now stands on the site of the original well, which the state has declared a historic site.
trains: Carlsbad grew up around the railroad. Its Santa Fe Depot, a Carpenter Gothic building designed by Fred Perris, was built in 1887, and it now houses the visitor center at 400 Carlsbad Village Drive. Today the NCTD COASTER stops at Carlsbad Village and Carlsbad Poinsettia stations, the Amtrak Pacific Surfliner stops nearby in Oceanside and Solana Beach, and BREEZE route 325 links the Village to the SPRINTER. For a train outing, try the Poway-Midland Railroad or Balboa Park's San Diego Model Railroad Museum.
train_links: Rides behind a 1907 Baldwin steam locomotive or a 1906 cable car in Old Poway Park, plus Christmas in the Park.
27,000 square feet of model layouts in Balboa Park, with a Toy Train Gallery and holiday toy trains in winter.
traditions: The Rotary Club of Carlsbad has lit the Village holiday tree at Village Faire for more than 40 years, with the mayor flipping the switch at dusk.
Santa, Mrs. Claus and an elf ride into the Village tree lighting on an antique Carlsbad Fire Department engine.
The City of Carlsbad decorates Leo Carrillo Ranch Historic Park for an evening of crafts, train rides, a movie and a tree lighting by the adobe.
The Forum Carlsbad marks the season with an annual tree lighting, a marching band, a light show and snowfall.
Chandler's at Cape Rey Carlsbad Beach hosts a free beachside evening with a tree lighting, letters to Santa and printed Santa photos.
kidfact: Carlsbad got its name from water. A sea captain digging a well found mineral water that matched the water of a famous spa town in Europe called Karlsbad, so the town took its name.
faq: Where is the Carlsbad Village tree lighting?

The Rotary Club of Carlsbad lights the holiday tree at the front entrance of Village Faire, 300 Carlsbad Village Drive, on a Sunday afternoon in early December. Santa arrives on an antique fire truck, kids make crafts with the Carlsbad Library's Learning Center, and the mayor lights the tree at about 4:30 pm. Photos with Santa are free.
What is Holiday at the Rancho in Carlsbad?

It is a City of Carlsbad evening at Leo Carrillo Ranch Historic Park with holiday lights, live music, cookie decorating, crafts, train rides, face painting, a movie, a visit from Santa and a tree lighting on the patio of the adobe ranch house. Tickets are presale only through Carlsbad Connect, and none are sold at the gate.
Where can kids see Santa for free in Carlsbad?

The Forum Carlsbad offers complimentary Santa visits in its Garden Area behind YETI on December weekends, and Plaza Paseo Real, already listed on our Vista page, hosts free outdoor Santa photos in its Upper Courtyard on two Saturdays. Santa also poses for free photos at the Village Faire tree lighting. Bring your own phone or camera.
Can we take the train to Christmas events in Carlsbad?

Yes. The NCTD COASTER stops at Carlsbad Village station on State Street, a short walk from Village Faire and the Village tree lighting, and at Carlsbad Poinsettia station on Avenida Encinas, closer to Cape Rey Carlsbad Beach on Ponto Road. Amtrak Pacific Surfliner riders can change to the COASTER in Oceanside or Solana Beach.

Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Carlsbad for 2026, and here is what he found: 12 family events in Carlsbad, 5 of them free. The magic runs from November 21 through January 3 (Holidays at LEGOLAND), with The Sea Star Search with The Elf on the Shelf at SEA LIFE Carlsbad (November 27), Coastal Holiday Magic Tree Lighting at Cape Rey Carlsbad Beach (December 3) and 24th Annual Tree Lighting Celebration at The Forum Carlsbad (December 4) along the way. We check every date on the host’s own website, and each listing links straight there. For the rest of the state, see our California Christmas events for kids guide.
